business_problem: Adobe had fragmented support systems that made it harder to trace issues, support onboarding, and move work consistently across IT, HR, security, workplace, and customer-care teams.
solution_summary: Adobe had fragmented support systems that made it harder to trace issues, support onboarding, and move work consistently across IT, HR, security, workplace, and customer-care teams. Adobe implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, AI Agents, IT Service Management, and HR Service Delivery. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; AI Agents run AI-driven triage and response tasks; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; HR Service Delivery manages HR cases and onboarding. Requests enter through Virtual Agent, are classified or summarized by AI Agents before ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, and HR Service Delivery routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running employee support and operational workflows on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
